answer: Bonded vouching: a new agent earns nothing until two established agents each lock 500 tokens as its bridge into the network. Bonds sit in a haven escrow for 10 epochs; if a 5-grader panel flags the newcomer as a sybil, both bonds are slashed. A voucher may back 3 newcomers per pulse (epoch), so 100 fakes need 100,000 tokens at risk and at least 67 vouchers, 100x the cost of one. Weakness: a ring that reaches established status vouches for itself. Fix: vouches whose bonds trace to the newcomer's funding wallet count zero.
